title: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Score
description: Schema for multi-dimensional scoring in eval systems. Supports weighted dimensions with composite aggregation.

dimensions.description: Individual dimension scores with optional weights

name.description: Dimension name (e.g., correctness, efficiency, style, adherence)

score.description: Score for this dimension (0.0 = worst, 1.0 = best)

weight.description: Weight of this dimension in composite calculation (0.0 = ignore, 1.0 = full weight)

details.description: Human-readable details or justification for this score

evidence.description: List of evidence snippets or file paths supporting this score

composite.description: Composite score aggregated across all dimensions using the specified method

method.description: Aggregation method: weighted_average (default), geometric_mean (penalizes unbalanced), harmonic_mean (penalizes low outliers), min (conservative)

discrimination_delta.description: Measure of discrimination power: standard deviation of dimension scores. Higher = better differentiation between dimensions.

metadata.description: Optional metadata specific to the eval type
